phases.name: Foundation & Core Data Layer
phases.description: Set up project scaffolding, data services, routing, and reusable components. This is the skeleton that all features build on.

subtasks.title: Scaffold Vite project with Tailwind and base layout
subtasks.description: Initialize Vite project, configure Tailwind CSS with custom design tokens (colors, fonts, spacing from architecture-spec.md), create index.html with sidebar + top bar + content area layout shell. Import Manrope and Inter from Google Fonts. Add Lucide icons via CDN.
completion_criteria: Vite dev server runs with HMR

index.html has sidebar navigation (5 items), top bar with timer placeholder, and content area
Google Fonts (Manrope, Inter) loaded
Lucide icons available

subtasks.title: Implement localStorage data store and service layer
subtasks.description: Create store.js (localStorage wrapper with caching, error handling, quota monitoring), employeeService.js, projectService.js, and timeEntryService.js with full CRUD operations, validation, and event emission.
completion_criteria: store.js handles read/write with try/catch, caches in memory, handles QuotaExceededError
employeeService: create, read, update, delete with validation (name required, max 100 chars, unique check)
projectService: project + task CRUD, status transitions
timeEntryService: CRUD, clockIn > clockOut validation, overlap detection, duration calculation

wtt_ prefix on all localStorage keys

subtasks.title: Build hash-based router and view switching
subtasks.description: Create router.js supporting routes: #/dashboard, #/employees, #/projects, #/timesheet, #/reports. Only the active view renders in the content area. Default route is #/dashboard.
completion_criteria: Hash-based routing works for all 5 routes
Active sidebar item highlighted on route change
Default route (#/ or empty) redirects to #/dashboard
Unknown routes redirect to #/dashboard
Only active view is in DOM (lazy rendering)

subtasks.title: Create reusable components: Modal, Toast, DataTable
subtasks.description: Build modal.js (open/close, form content slot, backdrop click to close, Esc to close), toast.js (success/error/info notifications, auto-dismiss), dataTable.js (sortable columns, filterable, row actions).
completion_criteria: Modal opens/closes with 200ms transition, closes on Esc and backdrop click

subtasks.title: Build utility modules: dates, sanitize, eventBus, export

completion_criteria: dates.js: formatDate, formatTime, formatDuration (Xh Ym), calcDuration, toUTC, toLocal

eventBus.js: on(), off(), emit() methods working

- **"Timer widget visible in top bar across all views"**: ✅ `updateDisplay()` (line 35) removes `hidden` class when timers exist, adds it back when empty. Initialized in `main.ts` line 21 via `initTimerWidget()`.
- **"Clock-in: select employee and project, timer starts immediately"**: ✅ Clock-in from Dashboard triggers `timer:changed` event, which the widget listens to (line 257). Timer bar appears immediately.

- **"Sortable by any column (date, employee, project, duration)"**: ✅ `handleSort()` (line 81-89) toggles asc/desc. `buildSortHeader()` (line 91-112) builds clickable `<th>` headers for Date, Employee, Project, Duration with ascending/descending triangle indicators.

All wired via `Modal.open()`.
- **"Validation: end time > start time, no overlap with same employee's entries, max 24h"**: ✅ Delegates to `timeEntryService.createManualEntry()` which calls `validateTimeRange()` (end > start + max 24h) and `checkOverlap()`. Errors displayed in `errorDiv` (line 321-323).
